Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option b 13.0 to 13.8 s. The map frame at 13.0 s, then a straight-down creek: brown water between wavy pale banks and round tree crowns, a pale rock slab upstream at upper left, and a white car roof with a dark pod at right center sitting inside a pale stone-dotted lip that bounds a lighter shelf. The lip reads as a thin pale line with dots rather than foam. Rain rings dot the water from 13.6 s. The car sits above the caption box; the caption covers part of the lower bank and a lower-left crown.
